scientific_question: local transition identification X_(k+1)=F(X_k,U_k,O_k), followed by separately evaluated prospective transport without future realized U/O inputs

time_semantics.local_transition_identification: The realized update U_k and optimizer transition O_k may explain the already executed transition from X_k to X_(k+1).
time_semantics.prospective_prediction: At a prediction cut r, no realized update, gradient, parameter, Adam state, capability result or label at r or later may be supplied. Multi-step prediction must recursively generate its state and use only a pre-frozen exogenous plan or a driver model trained without the held-out run.
time_semantics.earliest_divergence: Retrospective development evidence only. Leave-one-run-out distances, thresholds and feature choices are fitted on the other twelve runs.

window_policy.decline: Every legal complete post-formation decline interval contributes the 100-step window from the immediately previous native evaluation checkpoint through the first native evaluation confirming decline.
window_policy.stable_match: Every decline receives one stable next-interval control selected by a deterministic frozen standardized-distance rule without using future outcomes as model inputs.
window_policy.recovery: Exactly one complete recovery window per run is selected by minimum native validation accuracy, then earliest onset.
window_policy.deduplication: Identical entry/start/end execution windows are materialized once and may be referenced by multiple pairing records; duplicate references are not independent samples.

runtime_boundary.training_batch_policy: Load the content-addressed training_batch_inputs, training_batch_targets and batch_selection_order for each exact optimizer opportunity from the source training GFG.
runtime_boundary.historical_rng_boundary: Historical CPU/CUDA RNG payloads were not materialized. The admitted dropout-free path is reexecuted with a content-derived current-runtime RNG commitment and is never mislabeled as historical RNG restoration.
runtime_boundary.historical_exactness: Historical endpoint identity is true only if every available parameter and Adam hash matches. Otherwise report the deterministic current-runtime replay and per-object drift without tolerance repair.

occurrence_semantics.forward_and_loss: The native model forward is one occurrence whose outcomes include logits and loss; loss is not invented as a separate occurrence.
occurrence_semantics.optimizer_update: The native optimizer.step is one occurrence that changes Adam and parameter state; separate Adam and parameter occurrences are not invented when the implementation does not expose them.
occurrence_semantics.skip: A real forward/backward/clipping occurrence followed by ExplicitDisposition(OPTIMIZER_STEP_SKIPPED_BY_FROZEN_BRANCH).
occurrence_semantics.hybrids: parameter-only and optimizer-state-only are explicit state-composition analysis occurrences, not fictional native training occurrences.

independent_replay: Hash-rank and replay one pre-registered decline/control pair per run plus its key-step branches; selection is frozen before stepwise results.
candidate_sealing: No candidate may be sealed unless it beats frozen Stability V1 prospectively under strict leave-one-run-out, recursively transports state, reduces inherited and new counterexamples, passes temporal causal tests and an independent checker.
vm_policy: The persistent VM and original persistent AI session remain running and unchanged; the AI is not resumed before evidence validation.
